description: DEP-05 §When a quorum_expired dispute ends: a QuorumBegin after the dispute's fork point (last_valid_sequence) ends it unless its confiscation already confirmed; a quorum_expired DisputeEnter is armed on only while its ground stands (anchor past the governing expiry, no re-establishment since). Judged from the ledger, never the chain tip.
